# UX & Reliability Requirements Quality Checklist: API Action Loading Overlay

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, and clarity for UX interaction blocking and API reliability
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///Users/chanchai/workshop/CODE/ice-pos-web/specs/010-api-action-overlay/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all user interaction actions requiring overlay blocking explicitly identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are visual and tactile blocking specifications documented for touchscreens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are status messaging requirements specified for each distinct user action category? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are concurrent API request counter specifications fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are error dismissal and notification display behaviors specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the visual appearance of the backdrop quantified with specific opacity/color values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Are response time thresholds for overlay appearance and dismissal objectively quantified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Are timeout duration limits quantified with distinct values for general vs payment requests? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the distinction between user-triggered actions and silent background tasks unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do overlay styling and font sizing requirements align with Elderly-Friendly design standards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the silent background task exemption align with the constitution v1.5.1 mandate? [Consistency, Constitution §6.6]
- [ ] CHK012 Are error notification requirements consistent between API failures and timeout auto-dismissal? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, FR-009]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are fallback requirements documented for sudden network disconnection during overlay display? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are behavior requirements specified for multiple overlapping API requests with different messages? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are emergency escape requirements defined for edge cases where the browser hangs? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]

## Measurability & Verifiability

- [ ] CHK016 Can the zero duplicate submission requirement be objectively validated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Can the 100ms appearance and dismissal timing constraints be measured independently? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, SC-003]
